name: Crossbed
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking up a slot canyon: overlapping, cross-bedded sandstone walls with grained strata and dark partings close toward a blazing white slit of sky, their lips glowing pink up high, violet in the middle and blue to mint near the floor. A pale shaft of light sways slowly through the lower gap, with drifting haze and faint dust between the receding walls.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: How much luminous air sits between the wall layers, from crisp depth to deep glow.

params.label: Light shaft
params.effect: Brightness of the shaft falling from the slit and the motes caught in it.

params.label: Bedding
params.effect: Density of the flowing sandstone strata lines on every wall.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the dust motes and the haze sheets drifting through the canyon.
